subject: Request: Overnight concierge credit + 2-week trial extension for CloudPark
messages:
From: Alice Brant <alice@cloudpark.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 20:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: small credit + 2-week trial extension?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the CloudPark team was impressed with the latency numbers. We ran a short internal eval overnight and want to keep momentum. Two small asks so we can move to a procurement review this week:

- A $12k promo credit applied to our trial to cover peak token usage for the next 2 weeks
- Extend the trial window by 14 days so our SREs can run the end-to-end integration tests

If we can get these in place by Monday we’ll have procurement sign the SOW and aim for a Sept pilot kickoff. I can loop in procurement (procure@cloudpark.io) if you need a paper trail.

Attachments: none on my side — happy to share test logs if useful.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Brant
Head of AI Engineering, CloudPark
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: small credit + 2-week trial extension?

Ben — forwarding Alice's note. CloudPark asking for a $12k promo credit + 14-day extension. They are on the cusp of procurement.

Context: CloudPark ran an overnight eval and we saw a spike in token consumption due to large-batch ingestion. They’re a mid-market infra vendor; high upside if pilot turns into a dedicated contract.

Can you approve the credit as a one-off? If we greenlight, I’ll send a formal offer with attachments (pricing schedule + SOC2 excerpt) and a DocuSign link for the non-binding addendum.

Prefer to keep this within concierge credit authority if possible — I can do a partial split between promotional and trial extension bundles.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: small credit + 2-week trial extension?

Irene — good find. Approved under the following conditions:

- Credit cap: $12,000 one-time promo credit applied to trial billing (no recurring credits)
- Trial extension: 14 days, standard trial terms apply
- Attachments to include: pricing schedule v2 and SOC2 excerpt
- Require HubSpot deal update and procurement contact added to the thread (procure@cloudpark.io)

If procurement asks for an SLA exception or any enterprise terms, escalate to Laura. Otherwise proceed and send the addendum for signature.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700

Hi Alice / CloudPark procurement,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal approval, Redwood can provide the following: 

- $12,000 one-time promotional credit applied to your current trial (covers token consumption up to the credit cap)
- 14-day extension to your existing trial window

I’ve attached the updated pricing schedule and a SOC 2 excerpt for procurement review. Please review and confirm and I will send a short addendum via DocuSign for signature.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_schedule_v2.pdf (pdf), soc2-excerpt-2026.txt (txt).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CP-2026-091
DocuSign (pending): https://www.docusign.com/ue/embeddedSigning/abcd-1234

Next steps we suggest:
1) Procurement confirms acceptance of the extension + credit
2) Procurement signs the addendum (DocuSign link sent below)
3) We apply the credit and extend the trial the same day we receive the signed addendum

Let me know if you need a slightly different structure (e.g., split credit + monthly rebate).

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
